description: This file defines a QueryCacheManager class responsible for managing query result caching within the Superset application. It includes methods for setting, retrieving, and deleting cache entries, as well as handling cache hits and errors.

classes.name: QueryCacheManager
classes.description: A class for managing query cache storage, retrieval, and invalidation within the Superset application.

methods.name: set_query_result
methods.description: Stores the result of a query into the cache, updating internal state and handling errors.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached query result by key, with options to force query or cached data.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in the cache for a given key and region.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a cache entry by key and region.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a cache entry exists for a given key and region.
